tasks.label: Check Git operation status
tasks.command: git status --short --branch; if (Test-Path .git\index.lock) { Write-Output 'index.lock present' } else { Write-Output 'No index.lock' }; if (Test-Path .git\MERGE_HEAD) { Write-Output 'Merge in progress' } else { Write-Output 'No merge in progress' }; if (Test-Path .git\CHERRY_PICK_HEAD) { Write-Output 'Cherry-pick in progress' } else { Write-Output 'No cherry-pick in progress' }; if (Test-Path .git\REVERT_HEAD) { Write-Output 'Revert in progress' } else { Write-Output 'No revert in progress' }
